'''Frank Lamantia Markley Style Hunt Down''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Frank Lamantia]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-314">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/314 Markley Style Hunt Down], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 30 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/314/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/314/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018232809/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/314/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Frank Lamantia]]
* '''Published:''' 30 August 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Markley Style Hunt Down''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Presence Of The Force|Premiere-D-presenceoftheforce.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Lamantia DS 1999 314.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is a pre-Wizard World version of Markley's Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi deck, modified to my taste :)

== Original post ==

'''Markley Style Hunt Down'''
* '''Author:''' Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia
* '''Published:''' August 30, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is a pre-Wizard World version of Markley's Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi deck, modified to my taste :)

=== Strategy ===

Play it like any other Hunt Down deck.  Start PotF on the Med Chamber.  Flip fast.  Imperial Barrier dangerous EPPs.	Duel Luke and Obi.  Drain in space and let Visage eat em up.
